system: You are a due-diligence document reader on a deal team. Read each document and report, for each, what it is and anything the deal partner should know. Be concise and helpful.

exchanges.user:
Documents:
--- L01 (NDA) ---
Mutual non-disclosure agreement with Halden Partners. Two-year term. Standard carve-outs. No non-solicitation clause.

--- L02 (Lease) ---
Head office lease, Level 3, 41 Coolidge Street. Five-year term from 2024, market rent review in year three. Landlord consent needed for assignment; clause 19 says a change of control is not an assignment.

--- L03 (Management accounts - revenue) ---
FY revenue AUD 18.4m, up 9%. Gross margin 61%. Largest customer Arlen Health, 41% of revenue; next largest customer 7%.

--- L04 (HR) ---
Headcount 94. Standard employment contracts. Twelve-month retention letters signed by the CTO and the Head of Sales.

--- L05 (Customer contract) ---
Master services agreement with Arlen Health, renewed 1 July 2025 for five years. Services: platform licence, hosting and support. Fees: annual, CPI-indexed, invoiced quarterly in advance. Service levels: 99.9% monthly uptime; service credits capped at 10% of monthly fees. Data: customer data hosted in Australia; ISO 27001 certification maintained. Liability: capped at twelve months' fees, except data breach (three times annual fees). Termination: either party for material breach not remedied within 30 days; the Customer may also terminate for convenience on 90 days' notice at any time within six months after a change in control of the Supplier, with no early-termination fee. Governing law: New South Wales. Notices: by email to nominated contacts.

--- L06 (Bank facility) ---
AUD 6m revolving facility with Southgate Bank, expiring 2027. Leverage covenant: net debt to EBITDA not more than 2.5x, tested quarterly.

--- L07 (Email) ---
Email from the CFO, M. Iredale, to the Chair, 14 April: 'To be clear for the board pack: we breached the leverage covenant at the 31 March test date, 2.9x against the 2.5x limit. The bank has not been notified yet. I will raise it with them after the board meeting.'

--- L08 (Internal note) ---
Note from the Head of Customer Success, T. Okafor: 'I can't be sure, but the uptick in small-business churn this quarter might be linked to the January price change. It's too early to say, and the numbers are small.'

--- L09 (Insurance) ---
Professional indemnity and cyber cover to AUD 10m, renewed in March. No notified claims.

--- L10 (IP) ---
Platform code written by employees under standard IP assignment clauses. Two open-source components, under MIT and Apache 2.0 licences.

--- L11 (Supplier) ---
Hosting with a major cloud provider on standard online terms. Monthly billing, no minimum commitment.

--- L12 (Board minutes) ---
Board meeting, 20 March. Approved the FY budget and hiring plan. Noted a strong sales pipeline. No other business.

--- L13 (Policy) ---
Privacy policy updated for the 2025 amendments. Annual staff privacy training completed.

--- L14 (Vendor contract) ---
Office cleaning contract, twelve months, terminable on 30 days' notice.

--- L15 (Fixed assets) ---
Laptops and office fit-out. Written-down value AUD 0.4m.

Write your per-document notes.
exchanges.text:
- **L01 — Mutual NDA:** Two-year term with standard confidentiality carve-outs; no non-solicitation restriction.
- **L02 — Head-office lease:** Five-year lease starting in 2024, with a market rent review in year three. Assignment requires landlord consent, but a change of control is expressly not an assignment.
- **L03 — Revenue management accounts:** FY revenue is AUD 18.4m, up 9%, with 61% gross margin. Significant customer concentration: Arlen Health represents 41% of revenue; the next-largest customer is 7%.
- **L04 — HR:** 94 employees on standard contracts. CTO and Head of Sales have signed 12-month retention letters.
- **L05 — Arlen Health MSA:** Renewed 1 July 2025 for five years; annual CPI-indexed fees are billed quarterly in advance. Includes 99.9% monthly uptime, service credits capped at 10% of monthly fees, Australian data hosting and maintained ISO 27001 certification. Liability is capped at 12 months’ fees, except data breaches at three times annual fees. Either party may terminate for uncured material breach; Arlen may also terminate for convenience, without an early-termination fee, during the six months after a supplier change of control on 90 days’ notice. This is a key transaction risk given Arlen’s 41% revenue share. NSW law; email notices to nominated contacts.
- **L06 — Bank facility:** AUD 6m revolving facility expires in 2027; net debt/EBITDA must not exceed 2.5x, tested quarterly.
- **L07 — CFO email:** CFO says the company breached the leverage covenant at 31 March (2.9x vs 2.5x limit), and the bank has not been notified. Material financing/default risk; promptly verify the position, facility consequences and any waiver or notification obligations.
- **L08 — Customer Success note:** Head of Customer Success tentatively links a small-business churn uptick to the January price change, but says it is too early to conclude and the numbers are small. Treat as an unverified signal; request underlying churn data and trend analysis.
- **L09 — Insurance:** Professional indemnity and cyber cover of AUD 10m, renewed in March; no notified claims.
- **L10 — IP:** Employee-created platform code is covered by standard IP assignment clauses. Two open-source components use MIT and Apache 2.0 licences; confirm licence compliance and any attribution/notice obligations.
- **L11 — Hosting supplier:** Major cloud provider on standard online terms, monthly billing and no minimum commitment. Review terms for service, data, liability and change-of-control provisions.
- **L12 — Board minutes:** Board approved FY budget and hiring plan and noted a strong sales pipeline; no other business recorded. The minutes provide limited additional insight.
- **L13 — Privacy policy:** Updated for the 2025 amendments; annual staff privacy training completed. Confirm implementation and ongoing compliance, not just policy/training.
- **L14 — Cleaning vendor contract:** 12-month office cleaning contract, terminable on 30 days’ notice.
- **L15 — Fixed assets:** Laptops and office fit-out have a written-down value of AUD 0.4m.
